messages:
maya: quick thread — sharing the AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 bakeoff numbers and a proposed rollout corridor for model v2.1. need buy-in on canary gates + fallback rules before i kick the deploy job.

jonah: thanks — can you drop the high-level metrics first (latency, cost, accuracy delta vs fp16 baseline)?

maya: sure. condense:
- baseline: fp16 (hosted)
- AWQ-int8: mean infer cost -43%, p95 latency +6ms, QA exact-match delta -0.9% absolute
- GPTQ-4bit: cost -62%, p95 latency +22ms, QA EM delta -2.7% (more hallucinations in long context tests)
- FP8 (experimental hw path): cost -35%, p95 latency +4ms, QA EM delta -0.4%
- Safety golden set: AWQ flagged 8 regressions, GPTQ 18, FP8 3 (all triaged small prompt-sensitivity issues)

alina: fwiw the latency numbers are on A100s with batching profile that matches hosted traffic. Dedicated numbers look slightly better for AWQ (p95 +3ms).

samir: curious — what's the fidelity distribution across our eval corpus? are deltas concentrated on long-form reasoning?

maya: good Q. breakdown:
- short QA (<=64 tokens): AWQ delta -0.2%, GPTQ -0.8%
- long QA/chain-of-thought (>=512 tokens): AWQ -1.6%, GPTQ -4.1%
- summarization: AWQ -0.7%, GPTQ -3.2%
- embeddings cosine drift: AWQ median drift 0.6%, GPTQ 1.9%

zoltan: thanks. So AWQ looks like the best cost/accuracy trade for hosted + dedicated. GPTQ too risky for now given long-context failure modes. FP8 promising but experimental — requires kernel support across dedicated fleet.

maya: exactly. proposed rollout corridor:
1) Hosted: AWQ-int8 start at 1% traffic, monitor 24h, expand to 10% if no regression breaches.
2) Dedicated: AWQ-int8 start at 5% for existing reserved pools, then 25% after 12h healthy.
3) Private (customer-managed): no auto enable. send opt-in package + golden-set report.

jonah: what are the exact canary gates (metrics & thresholds)?

maya: suggested gates:
- QA EM uplift/delta vs fp16: must be within +/-0.5% (95% CI) on the golden set.
- Production latency p95: increase <=10ms absolute.
- Error rate (5xx/timeout): <=0.5% absolute increase.
- Safety/regression alerts: zero critical safety failures; non-critical regressions must be <=5 and triaged.
- Embedding drift: median cosine shift <=1.0%

samir: agree on the thresholds. add a behavioral gate: if we see increased repetition/hallucination signals from the automated quality monitors (LLR >0.2 on average) -> halt.

maya: added. fallback policy proposal:
- automatic revert to fp16 variant for the affected route if any gate breaches persist for 5 consecutive minutes OR if error rate >2% for 1 minute.
- deploy-bot will post rollback and create an incident stub.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: rollout v2.1-AWQ -> hosted (1%) + dedicated (5%). CI checks passed.

alina: operational notes: for dedicated pools we should pre-warm KV caches and set batch_size cap to 128 for AWQ to avoid p95 spikes.

zoltan: for private customers we should include a compatibility matrix: kernel support, quant library versions, and minimum GPU compute sm. FP8 row marked experimental.

jonah: can we codify the rollout config so ops can paste it into the staging route?

maya: yep, draft config below (paste into rollout API):
```json
{ "model_variant": "v2.1-awq-int8", "targets": [{"env": "hosted", "traffic_pct": 1}, {"env": "dedicated", "traffic_pct": 5}], "gates": { "qa_delta_abs_pct": 0.5, "p95_latency_ms": 10, "error_rate_abs_pct": 0.5, "embedding_drift_pct": 1.0, "safety_regressions_max": 0 }, "fallback": { "policy": "auto-revert", "reversion_variant": "v2.1-fp16", "breach_window_min": 5 } }
```

samir: tiny suggestion: set hosted expansion cooldown to 3h and dedicated to 1h, and require a manual thumbs-up for >25% traffic.

maya: done. updated plan: hosted cooldown 3h, dedicated cooldown 1h, manual approval for >25%.

ops-bot: noted. Creating canary dashboards: kaizen/quant-canary-v2.1 (will include token-level cost, p95 latency, QA EM by bucket, embedding drift, safety flags).

zoltan: one more: add an automated sampling of failure cases to the "quant-regressions" S3 prefix for quick postmortem. Include model, input, rerank score, and exact response.

maya: will add that to the deploy job. last ask — anyone object to trying AWQ-int8 in hosted + dedicated with these gates?

jonah: no objections from me. :+1:

alina: good to go from infra side. :rocket:

samir: fine by me, monitor closely.

zoltan: fine. let's not enable FP8 yet.

maya: thanks everyone — kicking it off now. i'll post final rollout IDs and dashboard links when deploy-bot returns status. :white_check_mark:
